context: Add value-level URI userinfo scrubbing after the exact-key classifier, drive database and HTTP-style URI sentinels through sanitize_platform_options, and retain non-secret URL/path/tuning values byte-for-byte.
description: Platform option values can contain credential-bearing URI userinfo even when their keys are not classified as secret. Scrub passwords and tokens embedded in URI userinfo before internal or public result capture, while preserving ordinary URLs, filesystem paths, tuning values, and explicit-key redaction.

preserves.behavior: non-secret filesystem paths and tuning values

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; out=sanitize_platform_options({"database_path":"postgresql://user:URI_PASSWORD@db.example/db","output_location":"https://user:URI_TOKEN@example.com/export","threads":4}); text=json.dumps(out); assert "URI_PASSWORD" not in text and "URI_TOKEN" not in text'
verifications.description: credential material embedded in non-secret option values is absent after sanitization
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because URI userinfo survives; exits 0 after value-level URI scrubbing

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; out=sanitize_platform_options({"url":"https://public.example/export","path":"/tmp/data","sort_key":"o_orderkey"}); assert out=={"url":"https://public.example/export","path":"/tmp/data","sort_key":"o_orderkey"}'
verifications.description: ordinary URL and option-value behavior remains green
verifications.expected: passes before and after as a regression guard
passes before and after as a regression guard
